bug_semantics: rancher/local-path-provisioner loads helperPod.yaml from the local-path-config ConfigMap (or --helper-pod-file), YAML-to-JSON-unmarshals it into a v1.Pod, DeepCopies that object in createHelperPod, then creates the pod on the target node during PVC provision/delete. Until v0.0.36 the loader accepted any pod spec: privileged securityContext, extra hostPath volumes, capability adds, hostNetwork/PID/IPC, custom serviceAccountName, initContainers, envFrom, and lifecycle hooks all survived into the created HelperPod. A principal who can edit that ConfigMap can therefore plant a privileged helper with host root mounted and steal node files or other pods' ServiceAccount tokens on the next volume operation.
